# VK Tickets

> > VK Tickets (VK Билеты) is Russia's leading online ticketing platform for concerts, theatre performances, and live entertainment events across Russian cities.

VK Tickets enables users to discover and purchase tickets for a wide range of cultural events including concerts by popular artists like Aleksandr Rozenbaum and Intonatsiia, theatre productions, and live performances at venues throughout Russia. The platform serves major cities including Toliatti, Ivanovo, and other regional centers.

## Concert Events

- [Intonatsiia — Tour 'Za Mechtoi' in Toliatti](https://tickets.vk.com/toliatti/event/intonatsiia-ost-molodezhka-za-mechtoi-849946): Concert tickets for Intonatsiia at MAISON venue in Toliatti, April 4, 2026
- [Aleksandr Rozenbaum Concert in Toliatti](https://tickets.vk.com/toliatti/event/aleksandr-rozenbaum-85677): Tickets for legendary Russian singer-songwriter Aleksandr Rozenbaum at KC Avtograd, June 12, 2026

## Theatre & Performances

- [Obnimi menia (Embrace Me) in Ivanovo](https://tickets.vk.com/ivanovo/event/obnimi-menia-861008): Comedy-drama theatre performance at Centre of Culture and Recreation in Ivanovo, April 3, 2026
